rawContent: Nonprofits are not immune from #MeToo cultures and sexual harassment vulnerability. Join us Wednesday, Jan. 22, as we host our next webinar on the topic with industry expert Lisa Brauner. https://t.co/ZSI7tBRJ4I

Tolerating toxic or unsafe work culture is a sure path to undermining the cause that brought great employees to your organization. Thank you to Lisa Brauner and Perlman & Perlman, LLP for this session on Nonprofit Risk Management in the #MeToo Era. https://t.co/yA2XOtUkdo
